name: Crisp elephant-ear fish
summary: Cá tai tượng chiên xù is a river fish fried crisp, shared at the garden table on Cồn Phụng.
origin: Cồn Phụng, on the national rural lunch list.
howToEat: Share it at the garden table on the boat day. The rural article names the fry and does not give a recipe.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng. The Mỹ Tho bank also serves this fish. This plate is the Ben Tre lunch list.
seoTitle: Elephant-ear fish at Ben Tre — crisp at lunch
